<thought>Carbon’s 13C isotopic pattern (≈1.1 % per carbon) explains the strong M+1 peak (~5.6 % of the base peak), indicating the presence of carbon. The additional M+2 and very low M+4 peaks match the natural 34S (≈4.2 %) and 36S (≈0.02 %) contributions, suggesting sulfur is also present. These two elements can be identified with confidence from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
